findings.title: Proceeds from Business Disposals has no plan data
findings.detail: Referenced by Cash Flow from Investing Activities but evaluates to 0 in every version.

findings.title: Add Cost to Serve % of Revenue
findings.detail: Cost to Serve has no ratio KPI — common in EPM reporting packs.
findings.prompt: Add a new KPI "Cost to Serve % of Revenue" = cogs / rev * 100.

findings.title: Contract Revenue (Transactional, Fixed Fee & Gainshare) moved EUR -1.36B vs Budget
